title: Back-time music to the end card
what_it_does: Places a track so its own final hit lands on the end-card cut, nothing looped or spliced, with optional varispeed (max about 1.7 %) to fit the cut grid.
when_to_use: Ending a piece on the music's real ending.
why: Different job from our beat-grid scorer (which picks cuts; this fits the ending), so it complements it. 65 lines.
